title: The Door That Lost Its Squeak
synopsis: Amy, Sue and Ben discover that the Story House door no longer squeaks after Grandpa Ed fixes its stiff hinge; Amy keeps the old sound mark on her map.
continuity_state: Before: At the end of season seven the Story House door still has its old squeak, as recorded by a curl beside the door on Amy's real yellow map. The hinge has grown stiff. Grandpa Ed and Sue live at Round Window Cottage, while Ben has his red scarf and the lantern remains tilted. After: Grandpa Ed attends to the stiff Story House hinge; the door now moves freely and quietly and its latch makes a gentle click on closing. Its old squeak is gone as a present sound. Amy keeps the existing curl on her map as a memory without erasing it. No bookshelf item, lantern, garden state or other belonging changes.
